trap.label: protect from
trap.wrong: Helmets protect the workers of accidents; they can’t to be idle.
trap.right: Helmets protect workers from accidents; they can’t be idle.
trap.why: Em português “proteger de acidentes” usa de; o brasileiro traduz como of. Em inglês, protect X from Y.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com protect from: “Helmets keep workers safe from accidents.”
Reescreva com can’t: “It is impossible that they are idle.”
Reescreva no singular: “Helmets protect workers.” (A helmet)
